import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import numpy as np
import json

# ── Load data ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    raw = json.load(f)['model_benchmarks']

dimensions = raw['dimensions']  # 8 axes
models = raw['data']

# ── Color / style map ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
family_colors = {
    'GPT':     '#3B82F6',  # blue
    'Claude':  '#8B5CF6',  # purple
    'Gemini':  '#10B981',  # green
    'LLaMA':   '#F59E0B',  # orange
    'Qwen':    '#EF4444',  # red
}

# "Top" models get extra visual weight
top_models = {'GPT-4o', 'Claude 3.5 Sonnet', 'Gemini 1.5 Pro'}

# ── Figure setup ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 9,
    'axes.titlesize': 11,
    'axes.labelsize': 9,
    'figure.facecolor': '#FAFAFA',
    'axes.facecolor': '#FAFAFA',
})

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(16, 8))
fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.06, right=0.82, top=0.88, bottom=0.14)

# ── Normalize each dimension to [0,1] for plotting ───────────────────────────
n_dims = len(dimensions)
n_models = len(models)

# Build data matrix
data_matrix = np.zeros((n_models, n_dims))
for i, m in enumerate(models):
    for j, d in enumerate(dimensions):
        data_matrix[i, j] = m[d]

# Axis positions: evenly spaced 0..n_dims-1
x = list(range(n_dims))

# Y-range for each axis (0-100 → 0-1)
ymin, ymax = 0, 1
norm_data = data_matrix / 100.0

# ── Background shading for key tradeoff zones ────────────────────────────────
# Reasoning (idx 0) ↔ Inference Speed (idx 6)
ax.axvspan(x[0] - 0.35, x[6] + 0.35, alpha=0.04, color='#6366F1', zorder=0)
# Multimodal (idx 4) ↔ Math (idx 2)
ax.axvspan(x[2] - 0.35, x[4] + 0.35, alpha=0.04, color='#EC4899', zorder=0)

# ── Annotations for tradeoff zones ───────────────────────────────────────────
ax.annotate('Reasoning ↔ Speed\ntrade-off zone',
            xy=(3.0, 0.96), fontsize=7, ha='center', va='bottom',
            color='#6366F1', style='italic',
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', fc='#EEF2FF', ec='#C7D2FE', alpha=0.8))

ax.annotate('Multimodal ↔ Math\ntrade-off zone',
            xy=(3.0, 0.08), fontsize=7, ha='center', va='top',
            color='#EC4899', style='italic',
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', fc='#FDF2F8', ec='#FBCFE8', alpha=0.8))

# ── Draw axes ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
for j in range(n_dims):
    # Vertical axis line
    ax.axvline(x=x[j], ymin=0, ymax=1, color='#D1D5DB', linewidth=0.8, zorder=1)
    # Tick marks at 0, 25, 50, 75, 100
    for val in [0, 25, 50, 75, 100]:
        ypos = val / 100.0
        ax.plot(x[j], ypos, 'o', markersize=2, color='#9CA3AF', zorder=2)
        ax.text(x[j] - 0.08, ypos, str(val), ha='right', va='center',
                fontsize=6.5, color='#6B7280')

# ── Draw polylines ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Order: draw lower-performing models first so brighter ones are on top
model_order = sorted(models, key=lambda m: sum(m[d] for d in dimensions), reverse=True)

legend_handles = {}
for m in model_order:
    y_vals = [m[d] / 100.0 for d in dimensions]
    fam = m['family']
    color = family_colors[fam]
    is_top = m['model'] in top_models

    lw = 2.4 if is_top else 1.3
    alpha = 0.92 if is_top else 0.55
    zorder = 5 if is_top else 3

    line, = ax.plot(x, y_vals, color=color, linewidth=lw, alpha=alpha,
                    zorder=zorder, solid_capstyle='round')

    # Collect legend entry (one per family)
    if fam not in legend_handles:
        legend_handles[fam] = mpatches.Patch(color=color, alpha=0.85, label=fam)

    # Label top models at their strongest axis
    if is_top:
        # Find the axis where this model scores highest
        best_j = np.argmax([m[d] for d in dimensions])
        ax.annotate(m['model'], xy=(x[best_j], y_vals[best_j]),
                    xytext=(0, 8 if best_j % 2 == 0 else -12),
                    textcoords='offset points', fontsize=7.5, fontweight='bold',
                    color=color, ha='center', va='bottom' if best_j % 2 == 0 else 'top',
                    zorder=10)

# ── Axis labels ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Shorten labels for display
short_labels = {
    'Reasoning':               'Reasoning',
    'Code Generation':         'Code Gen.',
    'Math / Quantitative':     'Math /\nQuant.',
    'Language Understanding':  'Language\nUnderstanding',
    'Multimodal Understanding':'Multimodal\nUnderstanding',
    'Instruction Following':   'Instruction\nFollowing',
    'Inference Speed':         'Inference\nSpeed',
    'Knowledge Recall':        'Knowledge\nRecall',
}

for j, dim in enumerate(dimensions):
    label = short_labels.get(dim, dim)
    ax.text(x[j], -0.06, label, ha='center', va='top',
            fontsize=7.5, fontweight='medium', color='#374151')

# ── Title and subtitle ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ax.set_title('AI Model Capability Profiles Across Benchmark Dimensions',
             fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', color='#111827', pad=22)
fig.text(0.5, 0.90, 'Normalized scores (0–100) · 10 models · 5 families · 8 capability dimensions',
         ha='center', fontsize=8.5, color='#6B7280')

# ── Legend ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
legend = ax.legend(handles=list(legend_handles.values()),
                   loc='upper left', bbox_to_anchor=(1.01, 0.98),
                   title='Model Family', title_fontsize=9,
                   fontsize=8, frameon=True, edgecolor='#E5E7EB',
                   facecolor='white', framealpha=0.9)
legend.get_title().set_fontweight('bold')

# ── Top-model callout in legend area ─────────────────────────────────────────
fig.text(0.93, 0.52, 'Bold lines = flagship models',
         ha='center', fontsize=7, color='#6B7280', style='italic')

# ── Axis formatting ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ax.set_xlim(-0.6, n_dims - 1 + 0.6)
ax.set_ylim(-0.12, 1.04)
ax.set_xticks([])
ax.set_yticks([])
ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['bottom'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['left'].set_visible(False)

# ── Footnote ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig.text(0.5, 0.02, 'Source: Synthetic composite benchmarks inspired by public evaluations (MMLU, HumanEval, GSM8K, MMMU, MT-Bench) · Scores normalized to 0–100 scale',
         ha='center', fontsize=6.5, color='#9CA3AF', style='italic')

# ── Save ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=200, bbox_inches='tight',
            facecolor=fig.get_facecolor(), edgecolor='none')
plt.close()
print('Chart saved to /app/output/result.png')

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch
import numpy as np
import json

# ── Load data ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    raw = json.load(f)['model_benchmarks']

dimensions = raw['dimensions']
models = raw['data']
n_dims = len(dimensions)
x = list(range(n_dims))

# ── Color map ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
family_colors = {
    'GPT':    '#2563EB',
    'Claude': '#7C3AED',
    'Gemini': '#059669',
    'LLaMA':  '#D97706',
    'Qwen':   '#DC2626',
}

family_fill = {
    'GPT':    '#DBEAFE',
    'Claude': '#EDE9FE',
    'Gemini': '#D1FAE5',
    'LLaMA':  '#FEF3C7',
    'Qwen':   '#FEE2E2',
}

top_models = {'GPT-4o', 'Claude 3.5 Sonnet', 'Gemini 1.5 Pro'}

# ── Matplotlib styling ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 9,
    'figure.facecolor': 'white',
    'axes.facecolor': 'white',
})

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(18, 9))
fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.07, right=0.80, top=0.88, bottom=0.15)

# ── Helper to get model data ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
def model_y(m):
    return [m[d] / 100.0 for d in dimensions]

def total_score(m):
    return sum(m[d] for d in dimensions)

# ── Trade-off zone highlights: connect specific axis pairs ───────────────────
# Reasoning (idx 0) ↔ Inference Speed (idx 6): band between these axes
band_y_top = 0.985
band_y_bot = -0.065

# Light shaded band connecting Reasoning (0) and Speed (6)
rect_r2s = mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
    (x[0] - 0.38, band_y_bot), x[6] - x[0] + 0.76, band_y_top - band_y_bot,
    boxstyle="round,pad=0.15", facecolor='#EEF2FF', edgecolor='#C7D2FE',
    linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.5, zorder=0, linestyle='--'
)
ax.add_patch(rect_r2s)

# Highlight Multimodal (idx 4) ↔ Math (idx 2): band between these axes
rect_m2m = mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
    (x[2] - 0.38, band_y_bot), x[4] - x[2] + 0.76, band_y_top - band_y_bot,
    boxstyle="round,pad=0.15", facecolor='#FDF2F8', edgecolor='#FBCFE8',
    linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.5, zorder=0, linestyle='--'
)
ax.add_patch(rect_m2m)

# ── Draw axis grid lines and tick labels ─────────────────────────────────────
for j in range(n_dims):
    # Vertical axis
    ax.axvline(x=x[j], ymin=0, ymax=1, color='#D1D5DB', linewidth=0.9, zorder=1)
    # Ticks
    for val in [0, 25, 50, 75, 100]:
        ypos = val / 100.0
        ax.plot(x[j], ypos, 'o', markersize=2.2, color='#9CA3AF', zorder=2)
        if j == 0:
            ax.text(x[j] - 0.12, ypos, str(val), ha='right', va='center',
                    fontsize=7, color='#4B5563')
    # Faint horizontal guide lines at 25, 50, 75
    for val in [25, 50, 75]:
        ypos = val / 100.0
        ax.axhline(y=ypos, xmin=(x[0]-0.35)/(n_dims-1+0.7), xmax=(x[-1]+0.35)/(n_dims-1+0.7),
                   color='#E5E7EB', linewidth=0.4, linestyle=':', zorder=0)

# ── Draw polylines ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Sort: draw dimmer (lower-scoring) models first, bright flagships on top
model_order = sorted(models, key=total_score)

legend_handles = {}
for m in model_order:
    y_vals = model_y(m)
    fam = m['family']
    color = family_colors[fam]
    is_top = m['model'] in top_models

    lw = 2.6 if is_top else 1.2
    alpha = 0.95 if is_top else 0.50
    zorder_val = 6 if is_top else 3

    ax.plot(x, y_vals, color=color, linewidth=lw, alpha=alpha,
            zorder=zorder_val, solid_capstyle='round', solid_joinstyle='round')

    if fam not in legend_handles:
        legend_handles[fam] = (mpatches.Patch(color=color, alpha=0.88, label=fam),
                               mpatches.Patch(color=family_fill[fam], alpha=0.5, label=fam))

# ── Model name labels for all models ─────────────────────────────────────────
# Label each model at its rightmost point (Knowledge Recall, index 7) offset slightly
for m in models:
    y_vals = model_y(m)
    fam = m['family']
    color = family_colors[fam]
    is_top = m['model'] in top_models
    fontweight = 'bold' if is_top else 'normal'
    fontsize = 7.5 if is_top else 6.2
    alpha_text = 0.95 if is_top else 0.65

    ax.text(x[-1] + 0.12, y_vals[-1], m['model'],
            ha='left', va='center', fontsize=fontsize,
            fontweight=fontweight, color=color, alpha=alpha_text)

# ── Trade-off annotations ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Reasoning ↔ Speed annotation (between axis 0 and 6)
ax.annotate('Reasoning ↔ Speed\ntrade-off crossing',
            xy=(3.0, 0.99), fontsize=7.5, ha='center', va='top',
            color='#4F46E5', fontstyle='italic', fontweight='bold',
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.4', fc='#EEF2FF', ec='#A5B4FC',
                      alpha=0.85, linewidth=0.8))

# Multimodal ↔ Math annotation (between axis 2 and 4)
ax.annotate('Multimodal ↔ Math\ntrade-off crossing',
            xy=(3.0, 0.01), fontsize=7.5, ha='center', va='bottom',
            color='#BE185D', fontstyle='italic', fontweight='bold',
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.4', fc='#FDF2F8', ec='#F9A8D4',
                      alpha=0.85, linewidth=0.8))

# ── Axis labels ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
axis_labels = {
    'Reasoning':               'Reasoning',
    'Code Generation':         'Code\nGeneration',
    'Math / Quantitative':     'Math /\nQuantitative',
    'Language Understanding':  'Language\nUnderstanding',
    'Multimodal Understanding':'Multimodal\nUnderstanding',
    'Instruction Following':   'Instruction\nFollowing',
    'Inference Speed':         'Inference\nSpeed',
    'Knowledge Recall':        'Knowledge\nRecall',
}

for j, dim in enumerate(dimensions):
    label = axis_labels.get(dim, dim)
    ax.text(x[j], -0.07, label, ha='center', va='top',
            fontsize=7.8, fontweight='semibold', color='#1F2937')

# ── Title and metadata ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig.suptitle('AI Model Capability Profiles Across Benchmark Dimensions',
             fontsize=15, fontweight='bold', color='#111827', y=0.96, x=0.45)
fig.text(0.45, 0.925, 'Normalized scores (0–100)  ·  10 models  ·  5 families  ·  8 capability dimensions',
         ha='center', fontsize=8.5, color='#6B7280')

# ── Legend ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
handles = [h[0] for h in legend_handles.values()]
legend = ax.legend(handles=handles,
                   loc='upper left', bbox_to_anchor=(1.012, 0.97),
                   title='Model Family', title_fontsize=9.5,
                   fontsize=8.5, frameon=True, edgecolor='#D1D5DB',
                   facecolor='white', framealpha=0.95,
                   borderpad=0.7, labelspacing=0.6)
legend.get_title().set_fontweight('bold')

# ── Legend area annotation ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig.text(0.935, 0.42, 'Bold = flagship\nThin = lightweight',
         ha='center', fontsize=7, color='#6B7280', fontstyle='italic',
         linespacing=1.5)

# ── Clean up axes ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ax.set_xlim(-0.7, n_dims - 1 + 2.0)  # extra right space for model labels
ax.set_ylim(-0.13, 1.06)
ax.set_xticks([])
ax.set_yticks([])
for spine in ax.spines.values():
    spine.set_visible(False)

# ── Footnote ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig.text(0.45, 0.025,
         'Source: Synthetic composite benchmarks inspired by public evaluations (MMLU, HumanEval, GSM8K, MMMU, MT-Bench)  ·  Scores normalized to 0–100 scale',
         ha='center', fontsize=7, color='#9CA3AF', fontstyle='italic')

# ── Save ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=200, bbox_inches='tight',
            facecolor='white', edgecolor='none')
plt.close()
print('Chart saved to /app/output/result.png')
